subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should `message(action=send)` visible sends support full `messages.responsePrefix` provider/model/thinking template parity by receiving selected-run context, or should tool sends remain limited to static and identity prefixes?
rationale: The current code intentionally skips unresolved selected-model placeholders because tool sends do not carry live model-selection context; choosing to add that context changes a core tool/delivery contract rather than a local bug fix.

options.title: Design selected-model context parity
options.body: Define and implement a selected-run context contract for message-tool sends so `{provider}`, `{model}`, `{modelFull}`, and `{thinkingLevel}` resolve like normal replies.

options.title: Keep static/identity-only support
options.body: Treat the merged partial fix as the intended behavior and update docs or comments so users know model-dependent prefixes are unsupported on tool sends.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution work
options.body: Track model/tool-send attribution under the broader model-attribution discussion and leave this issue as a linked dependency until that direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Design selected-model context parity
recommendation.body: Define and implement a selected-run context contract for message-tool sends so `{provider}`, `{model}`, `{modelFull}`, and `{thinkingLevel}` resolve like normal replies.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent history in message-tool unification and reply-prefix context, and this decision spans runtime/tool delivery contracts.
